$comment: Browser B0 PRESENTATION EVENTS; the stable lifecycle-event vocabulary the Control Center V2 design branch renders (avatar-facing narration/animation cues). These are UI EVENTS derived from backend session state + command results; they are NOT backend state-machine states (the DB state machine is creating/ready/presenting/closing/closed/failed/expired/revoked). Each event maps to observable backend signals so the panel can animate without owning browser logic.

planning.derived_from: a VisualPlanner proposal was produced (planner.propose returned a proposal)

navigating.derived_from: command result for verb 'navigate'/'click'/'scroll' with accepted=true

explaining.derived_from: operator/host narration cue (a speak line rides the existing queue. NOT owned here)

paused.derived_from: host paused planning/execution (B1 pause; B0 exposes the event shape only)

human_takeover.derived_from: human-takeover event (B5; B0 exposes the event shape only)

verifying.derived_from: a command was issued with verify=true, before the verdict resolves

completed.derived_from: command result verification == 'verified' OR planner proposal operation == 'done'

failed.derived_from: session.state == 'failed' OR command failure_category in {provider_error, verification_failed}
